name: prayer-times
title: Prayer Times
description: Prayer times in root search and the menu bar, kept in Apple Reminders two weeks ahead with start, jamaat and ending notifications.
author: smrehan

commands.name: next-prayer
commands.title: Next Prayer
commands.subtitle: Prayer Times
commands.description: Keeps the next prayer in its root search subtitle and keeps prayer reminders filled ahead. Open it to see today's prayers.

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: Prayer Menu Bar
commands.subtitle: Prayer Times
commands.description: Shows the prayer in the menu bar when it starts, before jamaat, and before it ends until you mark it prayed.

commands.name: today
commands.title: Today's Prayers
commands.subtitle: Prayer Times
commands.description: Start and jamaat times for today, prayed status, and the last 7 days.

commands.name: set-location
commands.title: Set Prayer Location
commands.subtitle: Prayer Times
commands.description: Pick your country and city from searchable lists, or use your current location, refreshed 30 minutes before each prayer.

commands.name: prayer-alert
commands.title: Prayer Alert
commands.subtitle: Prayer Times
commands.description: Optional Raycast popup for prayer start, jamaat and ending, with snooze. Off unless Alert Style includes the popup.

preferences.name: method
preferences.title: Calculation Method
preferences.description: Fajr and Isha angles.

preferences.name: madhab
preferences.title: Asr Calculation
preferences.description: Hanafi puts Asr later (shadow twice the object's length).

preferences.name: adjustments
preferences.title: Minute Adjustments
preferences.description: Shift start times to match your local timetable: Fajr,Dhuhr,Asr,Maghrib,Isha in minutes, e.g. 0,2,0,3,0.

preferences.name: ishaEnd
preferences.title: Isha Ends At
preferences.description: Used for the ending reminder and for counting Isha as on time.

preferences.name: dhuhrEndsAtShafiAsr
preferences.title: Dhuhr Ends At
preferences.label: End Dhuhr at the earlier (Shafi'i) Asr time
preferences.description: Dhuhr's time, its ending reminder and on-time check end when the shadow equals the object's length, even when Asr itself starts at the Hanafi time.

preferences.name: jamaatFajr
preferences.title: Fajr Jamaat
preferences.description: Fixed HH:MM (24h), +N minutes after start, floor5+N (round start down to 5 min, add N), ceil5+N, end-N (N minutes before the prayer time ends), or empty for none.

preferences.name: jamaatDhuhr
preferences.title: Dhuhr Jamaat
preferences.description: Same format as Fajr Jamaat.

preferences.name: jamaatJumuah
preferences.title: Jumu'ah Jamaat
preferences.description: Friday Dhuhr. Empty uses the Dhuhr rule.

preferences.name: jamaatAsr
preferences.title: Asr Jamaat
preferences.description: Same format as Fajr Jamaat.

preferences.name: jamaatMaghrib
preferences.title: Maghrib Jamaat
preferences.description: Same format as Fajr Jamaat.

preferences.name: jamaatIsha
preferences.title: Isha Jamaat
preferences.description: Same format as Fajr Jamaat.

preferences.name: dueAt
preferences.title: Reminder Due Time
preferences.description: When each prayer reminder is due. Jamaat falls back to start for prayers without a jamaat rule.

preferences.name: headsUpMinutes
preferences.title: Heads-up (min)
preferences.description: Extra notification this many minutes before the due time (start or jamaat); the menu bar countdown turns yellow from then. 0 turns it off.

preferences.name: startWindowMinutes
preferences.title: Just Started (min)
preferences.description: For this many minutes after a prayer starts, its menu bar count (e.g. "Asr +3") shows in green, then blue.

preferences.name: endingReminderMinutes
preferences.title: Ending Reminder (min)
preferences.description: Notify this many minutes before the prayer time ends. The menu bar keeps showing it until marked prayed.

preferences.name: jamaatReminderMinutes
preferences.title: Jamaat Reminder (min)
preferences.description: Notify this many minutes before jamaat; the menu bar shows it from then.

preferences.name: useReminders
preferences.title: Apple Reminders
preferences.label: Keep prayers in Apple Reminders
preferences.description: Off: prayed status and history stay in Raycast only, and no reminders are created.

preferences.name: alerts
preferences.title: Notifications
preferences.description: Reminders alarms work on your iPhone and without Raycast running. The popup has Mark as Prayed and Snooze, but only while Raycast runs. The banner is the extension's own macOS notification, also only while Raycast runs.

preferences.name: menuBarShowNext
preferences.label: Always show the next prayer in the menu bar
preferences.description: A started prayer shows (e.g. "Asr +12") until marked prayed or its time ends. The next prayer's countdown ("Maghrib -5") shows during the heads-up window, or all the time with this on.
preferences.title: Menu Bar

preferences.name: remindersList
preferences.title: Reminders List
preferences.description: Apple Reminders list for prayer reminders. Created if missing.

preferences.name: reminderTitles
preferences.title: Reminder Titles
preferences.description: Comma-separated names for Fajr,Dhuhr,Asr,Maghrib,Isha, used in the menu bar, alerts and reminder titles. Any language works, e.g. فجر,ظہر,عصر,مغرب,عشاء.

preferences.name: jumuahTitle
preferences.title: Jumu'ah Title
preferences.description: Name for Dhuhr on Fridays, e.g. Jumu'ah or جمعہ.

preferences.name: daysAhead
preferences.title: Days Ahead
preferences.description: How many days of reminders to keep filled, starting today (1–31).

preferences.name: cleanMissedAfterDays
preferences.title: Clean Missed After (days)
preferences.description: A missed prayer stays dated, showing as overdue in Reminders and Calendar, for this many days. After that its date is removed; it still counts as missed in history. 0 never removes it.
